identificationModule.briefTitle: Study to Evaluate the Safety of Subcutaneous Alemtuzumab in Patients With B-Cell Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Pilot Study to Evaluate the Safety of Subcutaneous Alemtuzumab (MabCampath, Campath) in Patients With B-Cell Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase II trial to study the safety and tolerability of subcutaneous alemtuzumab administered without dose escalation to patients with advanced B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia (B-CLL).

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* B-CLL that has failed fludarabine

Exclusion Criteria:

* Performance status grade 3

locations.facility: Dept. of Hematology, Karolinska University Hospital
